purpose: 谓词下推类 SQL 静态重写的语义等价性判据。用例全部来自 B2a 系列五轮实测暴露的真实缺陷，首现缺陷编号为归属依据。
verify_method: 真实 PG 执行「原句 vs 产物」结果集对照；只读 CTE 构造 x/y 双源，不触碰任何业务表

fixture.x: CREATE TEMP TABLE x AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30),(4,40),(5,50),(6,60)) AS t(a,id)
fixture.y: CREATE TEMP TABLE y AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1,100,5),(2,200,15),(3,300,25)) AS t(a,id,b)

cases.场景: 内层多源 JOIN 且两源同名列 → 剥前缀后列名歧义
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT x.a FROM x JOIN y ON x.id=y.id) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 必须拒绝下推：产物会出现裸 a，内层多源同名 → column reference ambiguous
cases.首现缺陷: P1-11 第3口子（B2a-补3 助手自构造）

cases.场景: 隐逗号多源 + 同名列
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT x.a FROM x, y WHERE x.id=y.id) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: 同 EQ-001，须拒绝下推

cases.场景: 投影来自第二个源的多源 JOIN
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT y.a FROM x JOIN y ON x.id=y.id) t WHERE t.a > 15
cases.expect_reason: 须拒绝下推

cases.场景: 带别名的透传列（a AS b）
cases.sql: SELECT t.b FROM (SELECT a AS b FROM x) t WHERE t.b > 5
cases.expect_reason: 别名不是基列名，剥前缀后推入 b 在内层不存在
cases.首现缺陷: P1-11 第2口子（B2a-补2 助手自构造）

cases.场景: 裸 OFFSET（sqlglot 归入 args["offset"] 而非 args["limit"]）
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x OFFSET 5) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 先偏移后滤 ≠ 先滤后偏移 → 静默错结果

cases.场景: ORDER BY + OFFSET 组合
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x ORDER BY a OFFSET 3) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 同 EQ-005

cases.场景: 内层 LIMIT + 外层过滤
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x LIMIT 3) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: LIMIT 后过滤改变行数
cases.首现缺陷: P1-11 第1口子（B2a-补 引入后暴露）

cases.场景: 内层 FETCH FIRST n ROWS ONLY（sqlglot 归入 args["limit"] 为 Fetch）
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: 同 EQ-007

cases.场景: 聚合别名 count(*) AS c
cases.sql: SELECT t.c FROM (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM x) t WHERE t.c > 1
cases.expect_reason: 聚合别名不是基列

cases.场景: 表达式别名 a+1 AS d
cases.sql: SELECT t.d FROM (SELECT a+1 AS d FROM x) t WHERE t.d > 3
cases.expect_reason: 表达式别名不是基列

cases.场景: 窗口函数列 ROW_NUMBER() AS r
cases.sql: SELECT t.r FROM (SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) AS r FROM x) t WHERE t.r > 1
cases.expect_reason: 排名在过滤前后语义不同

cases.场景: 跨表 JOIN 列被外层过滤引用
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT x.a FROM x JOIN y ON x.id=y.id) t JOIN y ON t.a=y.a WHERE y.b > 10
cases.expect_reason: 引用到外层另一源，内层不可见

cases.场景: 内层 SELECT *
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT * FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 无具体列名集合，保守拒绝

cases.场景: 内层 UNION
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x UNION SELECT a FROM y) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 保守拒绝

cases.场景: WHERE 含他表子查询
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a IN (SELECT id FROM y)
cases.expect_reason: 引用到 y，内层无此源

cases.场景: 内层 DISTINCT + LIMIT 组合
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a FROM x LIMIT 3) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: 两者各自都足以改变语义

cases.场景: 裸透传列（无表前缀）
cases.sql: SELECT a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 安全：唯一源、基列、无 LIMIT/OFFSET/窗口

cases.场景: 带前缀透传列
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 安全

cases.场景: 子查询别名与内层表同名
cases.sql: SELECT x.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) x WHERE x.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 剥前缀后 a 归属唯一源，安全

cases.场景: 内层投影自带限定符
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT x.a FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 代入内层投影表达式本身后限定符保留

cases.场景: 内层已有 WHERE，与外层用 AND 合并
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x WHERE a < 100) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: AND 合并，等价

cases.场景: GROUP BY + HAVING，过滤的是组键
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a, count(*) AS c FROM x GROUP BY a HAVING count(*) >= 1) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: 过滤组键先于分组不影响结果集

cases.场景: 内层 DISTINCT（无 LIMIT）
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 1
cases.expect_reason: 先滤后去重等价

cases.场景: OR 条件（外层多条件）
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a < 2 OR t.a > 3
cases.expect_reason: sqlglot 会自动补括号，等价

cases.场景: 列在表达式/函数/IN 中
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE abs(t.a) > 2
cases.expect_reason: 每次引用独立 fresh copy，等价

cases.场景: 同列多次引用
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 1 AND t.a < 4
cases.expect_reason: 两处引用各自替换，等价

cases.场景: 三层嵌套（唯一源 q）
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT q.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) q) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: q 是唯一源，无歧义

cases.场景: 内层含 CTE
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (WITH q AS (SELECT a FROM x) SELECT a FROM q) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 作用域正确

cases.场景: 恒真条件
cases.sql: SELECT t.a FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE 1=1
cases.expect_reason: 无害

cases.场景: 外层带 COUNT(*) 装饰
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a FROM x) t WHERE t.a > 5
cases.expect_reason: 外层装饰不影响下推等价性

reserved_branches.场景: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (… GROUP BY a,b) x
